author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#SpecualtiveEd
Sit not
Sentinel, staring
wantingly at gatekeepers
A Snowball of insignificance

Sit not
Sentinel, stoutly,
in cardboard
ticky tacky structures
long past
shelter,
shackles of
hope and promise

Sit not,
Sentinel,
cheering a
changing of the
guard

Instead strike
flints of Speculation
to spark
wafery-thin
papery perspectives
into Endarkend Dreams
of new tommorows
find flares and
torch gates
to plant Yams
of community in Phoenix
sounds of dancing ash.
#smallpoems
